notes.title: Patch Notes v 2.124
notes.content:
Optimized hit boxes to hug the plane. No more pesky WTF I wasn't even near that bullet.

Fix a glitch when changing the bomb to another key, if you pressed space bar it still released the bomb, stupid bugs!!!!

Preparations for utilizing Steam Cloud are hard at work. Please stay tuned and we hope you enjoy this patch as it brings more balance and optimization to the game.

As always continue to Soar Eagles!!!

notes.title: Patch Notes for v 2.12
notes.content:
- Fixed level 6 visual glitch at boss
- Fixed level 7 walls
- Added Un Stuck button “Q” for level 7
- Adding all 20 achievements “Don’t worry all your previous stats have been saved so if you’ve already unlocked it as soon as you launch the game there you go :)
- UI Fixes for all scenes
- Bug Fixes and optimization

As always we hope you enjoy this patch as it fixes bugs and optimizes the game for your benefit.

Next patch will include Steam Cloud support so you won’t have to worry about losing anything if you decide to switch computers. It will also include some new features that remove your score but give you buffs so choose wisely and as always continue to Soar Eagles.

notes.title: Patch Notes for v 2.01
notes.content:
- +100  movement speed for A10, SU47, & EuroFighter.
- +110  movement speed for F22.
- Fixed HP glitch when respawning, you will see your health accurately now.
- Optimized level 6 camera transition to be smooth when facing the Super Tank.
- Super Tank Pincer Cannon Optimized.
- A10 Level 3 Guns no longer cause lag and the sound loops properly now.
- Tutorial button now persists properly from Level to Level.

We hope you enjoy this patch as it fixes bugs, adds optimization for your benefit and balances things out to be more enjoyable.

Next patch will include 19 achievements, Updated UI to handle all aspect ratios and much more so stay tuned.
